candidates.concept: An adult paper conservator in a flooded Baroque archive lifts a waterlogged illuminated codex from a floating card-catalog drawer onto a transparent suction cradle while gilt shelving, labeled specimen trays, and reflected ceiling frescoes remain active parts of the scene.

An adult conservation photographer inventories detached fresco fragments in a half-flooded oval reading room, calibrating a humidity target beside color charts, numbered marble fragments, baroque alcoves, and rippled reflections.

An adult woman conservation scientist works beneath a dripping Baroque archive dome, aligning a vellum leaf under a glass platen while a chandelier-like pulley drying rack, humidity instruments, gilded stacks, catalog ribbons, and shallow floodwater form a complex but legible conservation tableau.

An adult archive conservator reconstructs a taxonomy of fractured wax seals at a raised worktable while floodwater drains through a stone channel, surrounded by magnifiers, drying screens, floating ledger boxes, and sculpted Baroque doorways.

selection_rule.comparison: Select the lexicographically smallest lowercase hexadecimal digest; candidate_order breaks an impossible digest tie.
